$schema: LLM benchmark/capability data — Tab 3 (Cost vs. Capability)
notes: Two headline scores per model: Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index (a blended benchmark score, higher is better, roughly 0-100 in this snapshot) and BenchLM's Value Score (quality points per dollar of *output* cost — higher means more capability per dollar spent). Where a model publishes multiple scores at different reasoning-effort levels (e.g. GPT-5.6's low/medium/high/xhigh/max), the 'high' tier was used for consistency unless only one figure was published.

models.notes: Intelligence Index at 'high' reasoning effort per Artificial Analysis (#6/199 models; rises to 53 at 'max' effort, level with Claude Fable 5.1).
